name: Code Meter
soft_passes: #2 dial optically centred but very large — bezel nearly touches L/R safe zone, tight margin, mass slightly high
#3 internal silhouette is a bare circle reading as generic dial/knob/clock; meter identity carried by arc colour+position, not shape
#9 skeuomorphic glossy dial is a consistent one-object quotation but photoreal instrument inside a modern Big-Sur squircle, and baked specular contradicts current HIG
failures: #4 16px squint: '%' collapses to a blob and the two-line 'CODE METER' wordmark smears to mud; only dark-disc + faint warm arc survive, killing the informational payload
#10 variant robustness: single-appearance baked raster (not Icon Composer layers); depends on the warm peach ground + baked gloss, so Dark/Clear/Tinted renders flatten or muddy it
#12 no-text check: baked 'CODE METER' wordmark (two lines) plus a '%' symbol — words shrink illegibly, don't localise, and duplicate the app label
light_model: baked studio/environment gloss, key light upper-left: bright specular on the raised bezel rim (upper-left) + secondary reflections lower-left and right (environment reflections of a glossy 3D object) + soft inner vignette on the recessed dial face; background is a separate soft top-down gradient; short baked shadows, coherent single key but rendered-object gloss the system would rather apply itself
layer_stack: recessed dark inner dial face (vignette/inner glow)
coloured gauge arc yellow->orange->red + bright endpoint pip
devices: redline quota gauge (arc ramps yellow->orange->red toward full, the fuel/tachometer redline; colour semantics ARE the product)
glossy skeuomorphic dial (raised bezel, baked specular rim, environment reflections, recessed vignetted face)
endpoint pip (single bright light dot marking current value at arc end)
baked 'CODE METER' wordmark set into the dial face
rhymes_hint: skeuomorphic instrument-gauge icons (glossy tachometer/speedometer/VU-meter/volume-knob dials with baked bezels + reflections) rather than the flat diagonal-tool or concentric-badge families; also warm-monochrome terracotta-ground icons and ring/arc-gauge monitor utilities (loosely rhymes with monitor tools like AgentPeek, though that one is flat-mascot not skeuomorphic-gauge)
notes: Resolution: 256x256 web render with TRANSPARENT corners (delivered pre-masked as the squircle; macOS rounding pre-baked). No 1024 master; gloss/specular are baked raster, not system-applied. All hex estimated from a downscaled/compressed source; arc colour stops approximate. inferred - single icon, single source. Mask corner radius unmeasurable. Palette is warm-monochrome: one extended warm hue family (peach->rust ground ramp + yellow->orange->red arc) over a near-black dial; accent reserved for arc + '%'. Weakest link inside a pass is #7 figure-ground: the tan wordmark on the dark centre is low contrast (~#45332E on ~#2E2422). Brand-coherence with cover.png: STRONG on device, PARTIAL on palette - the cover (dark UI) is wall-to-wall ring/arc gauges matching the icon's central motif, and its orange/red high-burn warning colour is exactly the icon's ramp, but the cover adds a green healthy/under-pace accent + dark ground the icon omits (icon shows only the warm 'burning' half of the app palette). Era-lag: another shipping utility icon that is NOT Liquid Glass, but lags BACKWARD past flat into skeuomorphic quotation (vs 1Password/AgentPeek which lag flat/Big-Sur) - same root cause: no Icon Composer layer authoring, so #10 fails.
